description: This source file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint, used as a liveness probe for monitoring the application. It sets up a Blueprint and a class-based view to respond with a simple JSON message indicating the application's health status.

classes.description: A Flask MethodView providing a health status endpoint that returns a JSON message.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check endpoint, returning a JSON with message 'Healthy'.
